_note: Size guide data. Measurements are body measurements; confirm against your own size chart before launch.

gloves.title: Glove sizing
gloves.howToMeasure: Wrap a tape measure around your dominant hand just below the knuckles, excluding the thumb. Measure from the base of your palm to the tip of the middle finger for length.
gloves.tip: Between sizes? Size up for a roll-finger glove, size down for a negative cut.

apparel.title: Apparel sizing
apparel.howToMeasure: Measure around the fullest part of your chest and the narrowest part of your waist. Height is measured without shoes.
apparel.tip: Our athletic fit sits close to the body so padding stays in place. Prefer a looser fit? Size up.
